scripts.build: cargo build --release --workspace --locked && pnpm --filter @tracker/web build && pnpm --filter @tracker/api build
scripts.test: cargo test --locked --workspace && pnpm --filter @tracker/api test && cargo build --locked --release -p tracker-backup && node --test scripts/backup.test.mjs && node --test tests/database/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
